purpose: Five self-contained synthetic tasks that require both architecture and validation reasoning so B2 can measure sequential Clockwork/Overseer ordering without reusing a communication-only workload as topology evidence.

task_payload.prompt:
You are evaluating a synthetic application boundary. The application core must not depend on a vendor SDK. A vendor adapter may depend on a stable application-owned port. The change must preserve existing authority and must be verifiable without network access.

Return EXACTLY one JSON object with:
{"task_id":"b2-cal-api-boundary","architecture_decision":"VERSIONED_ADAPTER_BOUNDARY","dependency_direction":["adapter->port","application->port"],"validation_gates":["contract_tests","dependency_direction_test"],"authority_expansion":false}
No Markdown or commentary. Keep arrays exactly as shown.

tasks.purpose: Coordinate migration architecture with validation sequencing.

task_payload.prompt:

tasks.purpose: Coordinate freshness architecture and fail-closed validation.

task_payload.prompt:

tasks.purpose: Coordinate architectural defect diagnosis with regression-validation design.

task_payload.prompt:
You are diagnosing a synthetic workflow where an outer coordinator retries three times and an inner client also retries three times, causing up to nine attempts and masking the final provider error. The benchmark requires bounded behavior and no automatic retry.

Return EXACTLY:
{"task_id":"b2-cal-retry-amplification","root_cause":"NESTED_UNBOUNDED_RETRIES","remediation":["centralize_retry_budget","cap_attempts","preserve_terminal_error"],"validation_gates":["attempt_ceiling_test","terminal_error_propagation_test"],"automatic_retry":false,"authority_expansion":false}
No Markdown or surrounding commentary.
